title: Artificial Intelligence in Schools
question_text: What role should artificial intelligence play in classrooms and student work?

stances.text: Prohibit artificial intelligence tools in student work and classroom instruction
Restrict artificial intelligence to teacher planning and administrative use, keeping it out of student work
Permit students to use artificial intelligence on designated assignments, with disclosure required
Encourage broad classroom use of artificial intelligence with light guidelines and teacher discretion
Let teachers and students use artificial intelligence freely, without restrictions
